entries.name: Priest
entries: Priests are devoted to the spiritual realm, drawing power from the opposing forces of Light and Void. From the Light—which priests might conceptualize or revere as the Holy Light, Elune, or some other force or entity—priests draw holy power for healing and protection. From Shadow, priests call on power to break the will and sap the vitality of their foes. Priests wield both forces to support their allies and devastate their enemies.
